cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Wonderful promotion. Your timing with the director's retirement was beautiful. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And how considerate of the vacancy to arrive when you were ready.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm choosing the most generous version available this morning.

mechanism: A organizes a promotion toast, lets B narrow the wording and keeps resentment visible beneath each attempted warm acknowledgment.
confusable: Unlike honest neutral congratulations, every accommodating compliment still draws attention to A competitive disappointment.
comparison: Toast length and director vacancy differ from a prize card wording dispute.
seedUse: D213-b retirement timing and happiness request; S02-b takes toast duty while changing words to retain B participation.
